name: Mikata / Suzuden (スズデン)

source.readFrom: Extracted from the desktop design frame.

character: Japanese CORPORATE / green-energy / sustainability site. Calm, minimalist, refined, and information-dense in the Japanese style. Soft green gradients, generous white space, small precise type, image-led 'works/partners' sections. Best for energy, manufacturing, B2B corporate, environmental, and any brand that wants a serious, established, eco feel.

primary.note: For Latin/English leads use Inter or Noto Sans as the equivalent; keep the same restraint and small sizes.

scale.note: Section titles like 'OUR WORKS', often with a small English eyebrow above.
Small, precise, generous line-height — Japanese-web density.
Small English label above a Japanese heading (CREATE, FLOW, PARTNERS…).

typography.notes: Small, calm type with lots of air; English eyebrows over the main heading are a signature. Restraint is the whole point — nothing shouts.

color.gradient: soft green→teal gradient (hero and full-width bands)
color.notes: Near-black-green ink on white / pale-green surfaces, one green primary used in soft gradients for the hero and full-width bands (BEYOND WORKS, JOIN US). Calm and natural. REUSE the light + soft-green-gradient structure; swap green for the lead's brand colour.

spacing.notes: Very generous vertical rhythm (~80–96px) with small, dense content blocks inside — the calm-but-information-rich Japanese balance. ~1100px content column.

button.shape: Slim, minimal, often just a labelled arrow link or a thin pill.
button.notes: Understated CTAs; the design relies on hierarchy, not loud buttons.

card.shape: Flat, hairline-bordered or borderless, generous padding.

table.note: Clean spec/stat tables (hairline rules) are common — good for numbers, specs, comparisons.

order.layout: Logo left, minimal nav + small CTAs right.
Soft green gradient band; a small English eyebrow (CREATE) over a short Japanese/heading, right- or center-aligned; very minimal, lots of air.
A centered paragraph statement of purpose.
A row of 2–3 flat cards (icon → heading → copy) on a pale surface.
A clean hairline table of key numbers/specs.
Heading + a multi-cell FAQ/benefit grid (dense, calm).
A darker green band: an eyebrow (FLOW) + a numbered step-by-step process.
A row of short trust/quality points.
'OUR WORKS' — an eyebrow + 3 labelled columns (each a category with a real photo + short copy).
'PARTNERS' — a row of 3 image cards with captions.
A full-width green image band (nature/site photo) with an overlaid statement.
A green 'JOIN US' band with an inline input/recruitment CTA.
An oversized brand wordmark + link columns + fine print.

reusableArchetypes: soft green-gradient minimal hero with an English eyebrow
full-width photo band with overlaid statement
craftNotes: Restraint + air: small type, hairline rules, soft gradients — nothing loud.
English eyebrows over the main heading give it a refined corporate feel.
Real photography (sites, people, product) carries the WORKS/PARTNERS sections.
Spec/stat tables are a strong device for data-heavy or technical leads.

reuse: Use for corporate / energy / manufacturing / environmental / B2B / technical leads that want a calm, established, refined feel (and for any brand suited to an understated, information-dense layout). Take the light + soft-green-gradient palette, English-eyebrow headings, hairline tables, WORKS/PARTNERS photo sections and generous rhythm. Swap green for the lead's brand colour; for non-Japanese leads use Inter/Noto Sans and keep the restraint.
